title: Everyone merges: each session merges its own PR with the merge tool.
ruling: Owner words, typed in the coordinator's session at 12:58 CST Nov 16 (relayed by the coordinator at 13:07 CST; not read by triage): "No now everyone merges message consultant, ensure it gives you the shpeal, and then spread the message to your lanes". The consultant's text (13:04 CST, relayed to lanes 13:05 CST; triage did not read it): each session merges its own PR with the merge tool (lane, standing, batch runner); lanes no longer hand a finished PR to runner 10. Limits stay: green run of the PR's own head, lane lint PASS, review rounds, record at the live head, merge tool only. Private repos (q_max, degen, home, ios-adblock, joyous) hold until PR #3590 and a setup PR per repo. Open: whether "everyone merges" lets a lane mark its own PR ready. Decision standing-merge-grant on main says marking ready stays the batch runner's (coordinator's reading; triage did not read the decision). The coordinator asked the owner in chat. Triage's own use of it (goal item 6): not taken. Triage merges nothing on a relayed word, and has no open PR of its own that is ready.
